app.name: WebPage2Doc
app.tagline: Open a page, click the icon and save it as PDF, DOCX or Markdown.

warnings.partialContent: Some content may have been lost: the page was saved as-is (fallback).
warnings.imageLimitReached: Image limit reached (200): the rest were skipped.
warnings.imageFetchFailed: Some images could not be downloaded (403/404) — alt text was kept in the document.
warnings.imageTooLarge: Image skipped: size limit exceeded (100 MB).

errors.UNSUPPORTED_PAGE: This page is not supported. The extension only works on regular web pages (http/https).
errors.TIMEOUT: Could not collect the page in time.
errors.EMPTY: The page is empty or did not respond.
